creative_brief.emotional_promise: A small mechanical character you bring to life with a deliberate turn of its side knob.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Twenty named pieces, permanent assembly, cord routing, controlled winding and safe reset each need a distinct readable teaching space. Three leaves can sit beside the model during setup.
creative_brief.physical_format: Six 180 x 240 mm portrait pages; three double-sided loose leaves, read in numbered order.
teaching_arc: Thread and secure the replaceable cord
Hold, wind, set down and release
typography: Body and labels: embedded Bitstream Vera
creative_brief.visual_motif: Circular eye and winding-wheel outlines, numbered round action badges, and precise ruled panels echo the robot's own geometry.

findings: Page 5 strip captions were cropped; similar poses needed explicit winding and holding guidance.
Page 4 axle label was displaced and the cord line did not show routing or exterior ties.
Backup half-hitches were unexplained; inventory labels were small.
resolved_changes: Removed clipped caption remnants and added complete numbered action captions, explicit frame grip and knob restraint text, and a clockwise knob-end arrow.
Aligned part labels and added a labeled hollow-axle schematic with a single cord strand and both exterior tie positions.
Explained round turn and two half-hitches as physical steps with a lettered recap; increased inventory labels to 8 pt.
Inspected all six final pages in color and grayscale and repeated assembly-to-reset first-owner reading.
Repaired oversized PDF hero stream using two lossless RGB tiles; decoded source pixels preserved exactly, other page content unchanged, and repaired cover inspected.
